observations: Photo 0: Silver laptop lid with HP logo, pink sticker on top left corner. No model number visible.

Photo 1: Laptop open, showing screen with Windows desktop, keyboard, and trackpad. 'EliteBook' text visible on palm rest. Intel Core i5 sticker on bottom right of keyboard area. Fingerprint sensor visible on trackpad.

Photo 2: Same view as photo 1, but screen shows Windows Task Manager with Disk 0 (C:) details: 473 GB capacity, 47.0 GB free, 426 GB used. Model name '82711 N1N6 5K Kyno 31008' visible in Task Manager window. No clear CPU model shown.

claims.evidence: Seller's text and 'EliteBook' visible on palm rest in photo 1.
No CPU model visible in photos. Intel sticker in photo 1 suggests Intel Core i5, but generation not readable.
Task Manager in photo 2 shows 'Memory 16.0 GB', but this may be system-reported and not verifiable remotely. No physical RAM slots shown.
Fingerprint sensor visible on trackpad in photo 1. Webcam visible above screen in photo 1, suggesting facial recognition capability.
Photo 2 shows Task Manager reporting Disk 0 (C:) capacity as 473 GB, not 512 GB. This is a direct contradiction.
Intel Core i5 sticker visible on bottom right of keyboard in photo 1 and photo 2.

risks.risk: Hard drive capacity is less than advertised (473GB vs 512GB)
risks.proof: Photo showing disk properties or BIOS/UEFI screen with exact drive size.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as 473GB drive, which is a downgrade from 512GB.

risks.risk: RAM may not be 16GB or may be non-upgradable
risks.proof: Photo showing RAM slots and installed modules, or system information from BIOS.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if RAM is 16GB, but unverified; if false, price drops significantly.

risks.risk: CPU generation not confirmed (claimed 8th Gen, but no visible model)
risks.proof: Photo of CPU model in system information or BIOS, or a screenshot of CPU-Z or similar tool.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as 8th Gen i5, but if it's older or newer, price may be inaccurate.

risks.risk: Battery health or condition not shown
risks.proof: Photo of battery health in Windows settings or BIOS, or a video showing battery life.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming battery is functional and healthy; if degraded, price drops.

risks.risk: Screen condition not fully visible (scratches, dead pixels, backlight issues)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of screen under white background or with full-screen test pattern.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming screen is in good condition; if damaged, price drops.

proof_requests: Photo of BIOS/UEFI screen showing exact CPU model and generation.
Photo of system information or CPU-Z showing RAM and CPU details.
Photo of disk properties or BIOS showing exact drive size.
Close-up photo of screen under white background to check for defects.
Photo of battery health in Windows settings or BIOS.
response.reason: The model is identifiable as HP EliteBook 840 G6, but key claims like 512GB drive are contradicted by the 473GB shown in Task Manager, and other claims (RAM, CPU generation) are unverified. Hidden risks like battery health and screen condition cannot be assessed. Proof is needed to confirm specifications and condition before pricing.
